scope.surface: Inline Files panel with Add panel surface menu open

productLoss: Web anchors its 128x122 menu below the 28x28 add trigger at x=853,y=42; Lynx opens a 142x146 menu to the trigger's left at x=638,y=43.5.
Web rows are 118x28 with 4px vertical and 8px horizontal padding at 14px/20px. Lynx rows are 140x34 with 8px/12px padding and resolve at 16px, creating a visibly oversized menu.
Web uses 83.6% #191919 glass, a 10% light border, 10px radius, and 80% shadow. Lynx uses opaque #1a1a1f, an 8% border, 8px radius, and no shadow.
The 360x165 menu envelope measures 22.709175 MAE with 50.9815% significant pixels.
productBehaviorPassing: Both render Browser, Terminal, Files, and Diff in the same order.
Both mark Browser disabled and leave Terminal, Files, and Diff enabled.
Both menus open through the real add-surface trigger on an inline Files panel and retain zero console errors.
harnessMismatch: The first baseline attempt measured only three Web rows because the disabled Browser item is wrapped by a TooltipTrigger outside the popup's descendant tree.
The second attempt still used the descendant-only row collector.
The third attempt captured all four rows and matching disabled semantics, but the readiness gate read measurement.width instead of measurement.rect.width.
All three invalid attempts are excluded from product attribution. The fourth pair passes state identity and semantic gates.
classification.evidenceBoundary: One immutable snapshot, selected project and thread, dark theme, 1280x820 viewport, shipping Web and Lynx-for-Web bundles, inline Files surface, real add-menu triggers, four matching labels, matching disabled semantics, zero console errors, clean leak gates, and screenshot budget below 100. Native remains unobserved and conservative unknown.

denominatorChange.reason: The top-bar Add panel surface menu is a distinct user-reachable overlay with disabled availability semantics and surface-navigation actions that was absent from the fixed model.
